extraction.name: LUMA: A Benchmark Dataset for Learning from Uncertain and Multimodal Data
extraction.description: LUMA is a multimodal dataset designed for learning from uncertain data, featuring audio, image, and textual data from 50 classes.
extraction.creator: Grigor Bezirganyan, Sana Sellami, Laure Berti-Équille, and Sébastien Foumier
extraction.citeAs: Grigor Bezirganyan, Sana Sellami, Laure Berti-Équille, and Sébastien Foumier. 2025. LUMA: A Benchmark Dataset for Learning from Uncertain and Multimodal Data. In Proceedings of the 48th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval (SIGIR ’25), July 13–18, 2025, Padua, Italy. ACM, New York, NY, USA, 10 pages. https://doi.org/10.1145/3726302.3730302
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The LUMA dataset is composed of image, audio, and text modalities collected from various sources. Images are from the CIFAR-10/100 dataset, audio samples are extracted from The Spoken Wikipedia, LibriSpeech, and Mozilla Common Voice corpora, and text data is generated using the Gemma-7B Large Language Model (LLM).
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Physical data collection, Software Collection, Web Scraping, Web API
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw data collection includes 25,200 images from CIFAR-10/100, 135,096 speech audio recordings, and 62,875 text passages.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: The dataset allows for controlled injection of varying types and degrees of uncertainty to achieve and tailor specific experiments and benchmarking initiatives.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The dataset compilation involves validating and aligning the different modalities, ensuring that each text passage is related to the object in the corresponding image, and each audio recording is the pronunciation of the object label in the image.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotations (labels, ratings) were created by human annotators using Label Studio for audio validation, with 2 annotations per sample from 17 annotators.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The annotations were analyzed to ensure validity, with automatic validation using OpenAI’s Whisper Large V3 model for audio transcription, and manual validation for false negatives.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: M.Sc. and PhD students, and professors with advanced to fluent English knowledge
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: OpenAI’s Whisper Large V3 model, Gemma-7B Instruct Large Language Model (LLM)
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Sensitive human attributes collected include gender, age, and cultural information
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset aims to promote and support the development, evaluation, and benchmarking of trustworthy and robust multimodal deep learning approaches for safety-critical applications.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset contains biases, particularly in the text modality, with a high level of gender bias in classes like 'man', 'woman', 'boy', and 'girl'.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset may contain factual inaccuracies or biases, and its use is intended for benchmarking uncertainty quantification in multimodal classification settings, not as a source of knowledge or information.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation, Fine Tuning, and Uncertainty Quantification
